content: The patient should be instructed to monitor their symptoms closely and report any concerning changes to the transplant team every 24 to 48 hours. They can be advised to maintain communication through teleconsultation, allowing for diagnostic tests to be conducted as needed, symptoms to be monitored, and any alarming developments to be promptly communicated to the transplant team within the specified time frame of 24 to 48 hours. Currently, various investigational and experimental pharmacological therapies are being evaluated for the treatment of COVID-19. The overall cost of treatment is largely influenced by the number and severity of complications related to COVID-19 that an individual develops.
